# CNI_BOOTSTRAP

A CNI's bootstrap manifest, applied by the provisioner before the first node is Ready.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `cniBootstrap`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.cniBootstrap`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| --- | --- |
| manifest | string |
| name | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
